results.content: # Intergenerational mobility in Latin America: the multiple facets of social status and the role of mothers. results.title: Matías Ciaschi
results.content: Matías Ciaschi is a senior researcher at the Center for Distributive, Labor and Social Studies (CEDLAS) of the National University of La Plata (UNLP). He holds a Bachelor Degree in Economics from UNLP, a Master Degree in Economics and a PhD in Economics from UNLP. He has participated in research projects related to topics such as intergenerational mobility, labor economics, poverty, income distribution, and gender. * PhD., Economics, Universidad Nacional de La Plata, 2023. * M.A., Economics, Universidad Nacional de La Plata, 2018. * B.S., Economics, Universidad Nacional de La Plata, 2014. #### TEACHING EXPERIENCE. * 2023- Present Computational Methods, M.A. in Economics, Universidad Nacional de La Plata. * 2021- Present Labor Economics, M.A. in Public Finances, Universidad Nacional de La Plata. * 2017-2021 Teaching Assistant, Impact Evaluation, M.A. in Economics, Universidad Nacional de La Plata. * 2017- Present Teaching Assistant, Advanced Microeconomics, M.A. in Economics, Universidad Nacional de La Plata. * 2023-Present Associate Professor, Microeconomics,B.A. in Economics, Universidad Nacional de La Plata. * 2021-Present Head of practical assignments, International Economics, B.A. in Economics, Universidad Nacional de La Plata. * 2013-2020 Teaching Assistant, International Economics, B.A. in Economics, Universidad Nacional de La Plata. * 2012-2014 Teaching Assistant, Public Finances, B.A. in Economics, Universidad Nacional de La Plata. * 2014-2015 Teaching Assistant, Macroeconomics II, B.A. in Economics, Universidad Nacional de La Plata. * November, 2019 Teaching Assistant, Curso Teórico-Práctico de Evaluación de Impacto de Políticas Públicas – Nivel Intermedio. Organized by CEDLAS and SIEMPRO. * October, 2018 Teaching Assistant, Curso Teórico-Práctico de Evaluación de Impacto de Políticas Públicas – Nivel Intermedio. Organized by CEDLAS and IDRC. * September, 2016 Teaching Assistant, Curso de Incidencia de las Políticas Públicas. Organized by CEDLAS in the Secretaria de Hacienda de la Nación. * October, 2016 Teaching Assistant, Curso Teórico-Práctico de Evaluación de Impacto de Políticas Públicas – Nivel Intermedio. Organized by CEDLAS and IDRC. * June-July, 2016 Teaching Assistant, Curso Teórico-Práctico sobre Mercados Laborales, Pobreza y Desigualdad en América Latina. Organized by CEDLAS and IDRC. #### AWARDS AND HONORS. * YOUNG RESEARCHER AWARD, AAEP-Special Mention-2019. * UNLP Research Fellowship (2016-2019). * CONICET Research Fellowship (2020-nowadays). * YOUNG RESEARCHER AWARD, NIP Uruguay (2020).
